metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent attempted to browse spider-man toys on Kohl's website and sort by lowest price. Encountered Access Denied initially, eventually loaded kohls.com and typed 'spider-man toys for kids' in the search bar (steps 8-13). Search results page returned Access Denied again at step 15, causing the agent to exhaust its budget.

The URL after search will contain 'kohls.com' and 'spider', which the initial state (kohls.com homepage URL) does not satisfy.
